content:
Chase recently added multiple new offers to its popular Sapphire Preferred credit card, including a free one-year Apple TV or Apple One discount. Details are as follows.

Chase Sapphire Preferred now offers a free one-year Apple TV subscription, with the option to rotate to an Apple One credit.

Apple TV has long been an exclusive perk for Chase Sapphire Reserve cardholders. However, that card carries an annual fee of US$795.

However, Chase recently announced that Sapphire Preferred cardholders can now also enjoy free Apple TV.

Chase Sapphire Preferred is a travel rewards-focused credit card with an annual fee of just US$95, making it far more affordable than the higher-end Reserve card.

Sapphire Preferred cardholders must activate the offer on or before December 31, 2026 to enjoy a free one-year Apple TV subscription.

Both new and existing cardholders are eligible for this offer — simply link your Apple account to Chase through the Benefits section of the Chase app or website.

The free one-year Apple TV subscription is worth approximately US$156 and joins a suite of generous perks available with Sapphire Preferred.

Notably, current Apple One subscribers can rotate to a monthly US$7.50 credit, making Apple's bundle services even more affordable.

Similarly, by linking your Apple account to Chase as described above, the credit will be automatically applied each month for up to 12 months to any Apple One plan you subscribe to.

Therefore, whether you are already subscribed to Apple One or plan to subscribe now, you can benefit from Chase's new offers.

In addition, even if you hold the higher-fee Chase Sapphire Reserve, as an Apple One subscriber you can now receive a US$15 monthly credit, as the card already includes free Apple TV and Apple Music. Previously, Apple One subscribers were largely unable to enjoy related rewards.

Apple TV costs US$12.99 per month, or can be purchased at a discount through the Apple One bundle.
